cases.sentence: В шестом году, в ___ шестого месяца , когда я сидел у себя дома, и старейшины Иудеи сидели передо мной, рука Владыки, Господа, снизошла на меня там.
cases.explain: «пятый день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord Yahweh’s hand fell on me there.

cases.sentence: В шестом году, в пятый день ___ , когда я сидел у себя дома, и старейшины Иудеи сидели передо мной, рука Владыки, Господа, снизошла на меня там.
cases.explain: «шестого месяца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord Yahweh’s hand fell on me there.

cases.sentence: Дух поднял меня между землей и небом и в видениях Божьих принес меня в Иерусалим, ко входу в ___ внутреннего двора, где стоял идол, вызывающий Божью ревность.
cases.explain: «северные ворота» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north; where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

cases.sentence: Дух поднял меня между землей и небом и в видениях Божьих принес меня в Иерусалим, ко входу в северные ворота ___, где стоял идол, вызывающий Божью ревность.
cases.explain: «внутреннего двора» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north; where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

cases.sentence: Я вошел, посмотрел и увидел нарисованные на стенах кругом изображения всяких ползучих тварей, ___ и всех идолов дома Израиля.
cases.explain: «мерзких животных» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: So I went in and looked, and saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.

cases.sentence: Каждый держал в руке кадильницу, и поднималось ___ дыма.
cases.explain: «благовонное облако» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up.

cases.sentence: Он привел меня ко входу в ___ Господнего дома, и я увидел сидящих там женщин, которые оплакивали Таммуза .
cases.explain: «северные ворота» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of Yahweh’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.

cases.sentence: Он ввел меня во ___ Господнего дома; там, у входа в храм, между притвором и жертвенником было около двадцати пяти мужчин.
cases.explain: «внутренний двор» — after the preposition «во», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He brought me into the inner court of Yahweh’s house; and I saw at the door of Yahweh’s temple, between the porch and the altar, there were about twenty-five men, with their backs toward Yahweh’s temple, and their faces toward the east. They were worshiping the sun toward the east.

cases.sentence: Обратившись спиной к ___, а лицами на восток, они поклонялись солнцу на востоке.
cases.explain: «Господнему храму» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: He brought me into the inner court of Yahweh’s house; and I saw at the door of Yahweh’s temple, between the porch and the altar, there were about twenty-five men, with their backs toward Yahweh’s temple, and their faces toward the east. They were worshiping the sun toward the east.

cases.sentence: Пусть кричат Мне в ___, Я не стану их слушать.
cases.explain: «самые уши» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”
